steps.name: GenerateSceneDescription
steps.label: Generate Scene Description
steps.goal:
Capture the model scene description (geometry/materials/assignments)
and persist it onto the version MSD's ``data`` payload. Delegates to
``mdl.query.get_msd_data`` (in-process).

The payload MUST land in ``version_msd.data``: that is the only field
``PathObject.copy_files`` carries forward when the version is published
(it drops the copied .msd and re-commits a fresh manifest, then copies
``data`` across). Stashing it only in ``shared_data`` — as this step used
to — leaves the published .msd with ``data == {}`` and an empty
``materials_index``, which starves the ldv build recipe of the
material->geo map it consumes as source of truth.
steps.min_scenario: Someone hand-enters the notes/metadata for the records — quick when they bother.
steps.max_scenario: It's left blank; downstream has no context for what changed and has to ask around or guess.
